name: Neko
description: 🐈 Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser that streams a fully interactive web browsing experience directly to the user's device using WebRTC. It provides access to a secure, sandboxed browser environment that runs independently of the user's local system, ensuring privacy and isolation. The browser is rendered remotely, and all interactions are transmitted in real time, resulting in a smooth and low-latency experience.
short_desc: A self-hosted virtual browser powered by WebRTC
author: m1k1o
